verdict.rationale: Billing granularity is a fair question for a cloud sandbox service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents per-second or usage-based billing. The pricing items only mention customizable CPU/RAM, session-length and concurrency limits, and $100 in starting credits; kill, timeout and pause/resume are lifecycle controls, not a billing model.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can pay per second only for the compute a sandbox actually uses
